# Reserver

> Reservation software for restaurants. Flat monthly fee, zero per-booking commission. Bookings, no-show prevention with Stripe pre-authorization, guest CRM, AI chatbot and voice assistant, and Google Reserve — all in one platform.

Reserver is an all-in-one SaaS platform for restaurants to manage the full reservation lifecycle: inbound from web widget, Google Reserve, phone or AI chatbot; floor management with zones and virtual tables; automatic reminders; Stripe-backed no-show prevention; guest database owned by the restaurant (not a platform); and email/SMS marketing. Unlike TheFork, Covermanager or OpenTable, Reserver charges a fixed monthly fee (Free, Pro €49/mo, Plus €99/mo) instead of per-booking commissions. Available in Spanish (default) and English.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/): Hub listing all modules organised by area
- [Reservation management](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/reservations/): 14 states, tags, auditable history, live modifications
- [Floor & tables](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/floor-and-tables/): Zones, physical tables, virtual combinations, optimised auto-assignment
- [Shifts & services](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/shifts/): Services with hours, per-slot saturation thresholds, weekly and yearly calendars
- [Booking widget](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/booking-widget/): Embeddable widget on your own site with your branding
- [AI assistant](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/ai-assistant/): Conversational chatbot with function calling for real bookings
- [Voice AI](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/voice-ai/): Dedicated phone number that answers real calls, powered by Vapi
- [No-show prevention](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/no-shows/): Real Stripe pre-authorization holds with configurable policy
- [Guest CRM](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/customer-crm/): Complete per-guest profile, tags, history, CSV export
- [Marketing](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/marketing/): Email and SMS campaigns with segmentation and dynamic variables
- [Waiting list](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/waiting-list/): Automatic alerts to the next in line when a seat opens
- [Analytics](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/analytics/): Occupancy, no-show rate, lead time, source, CSV exports
- [Desktop](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/desktop/): Real-time view of today’s reservations, with fast booking, walk-ins, QR reader and push notifications
- [Reserve with Google](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/product/reserve-with-google/): Official Google Reserve API v3 integration

- [Integrations hub](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/integrations/): All 8 official integrations
- [Stripe](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/integrations/stripe/): Payments, pre-auth, automatic no-show capture
- [Google Reserve](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/integrations/google-reserve/): Sync with Google Maps and Search
- [OpenAI](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/integrations/openai/): GPT-4o and other models for chatbot and voice
- [Vapi](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/integrations/vapi/): Phone voice infrastructure for the voice AI
- [SMSUp](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/integrations/smsup/): SMS transactional and campaigns
- [Telegram](https://www.reserver-app.com/en/integrations/telegram/): Real-time team notifications
